selection_rule: Use feasibility only to decide whether to implement one opt-in bounded component-retention ablation. Do not launch the next inference round before current branch vectors are independently admitted; never promote from this probe or tune thresholds on reference pairs.
limitations: Reference-exposed diagnostic, not a new search, orthology inference or accuracy improvement.
